Reallocating Transactions in Native Banner
Picture guide 
(updated jan 2023- purchasing card office)
Details
Reallocation of Purchasing Card transactions is accomplished online via a web-based-secure program- Native Banner Finance
Account and/or business managers can make changes to the Fund, Organization, Account and Program (FOAP) or redistribute the FOAP information for Purchasing Card (P-Card) transactions.
Initial access to this program is given via the Comptroller’s office

https://gateway.morgan.edu/
